messages:
maya: Quick pulse 1 1 Need one consolidated roadmap doc that ties routing policy, tenancy lanes, canary gates, and launch criteria. Owners + draft by EOD Wed so I can prep the PI deck.

sam: +1. Propose a tiny executable policy spec: primitives should be lane, residency, fallback_order, model_compat, quality_budget. Keep it machine-readable.

jana: From customer interviews: three clear asks 1 enterprise residency & SLA, scaleups want predictable latency, startups want lowest-cost lane. I'll map examples and contract phrasing.

rolf: Ops redlines: do not run pinned-region canaries without per-tenant telemetry and automated evacuation runbooks. Pre-canary checks: per-tenant p50/p95/p99, eviction_rate, cache_warmup, and capacity_headroom. Block otherwise. :no_entry_sign:

ben: I'll build a prioritization sheet (impact, effort, infra_risk). Suggest weighting customer_impact heavier. Will add example scores for 8 asks.

taylor: I can make a 3-slide review: TL;DR, lanes->customers map, gating checklist. When's review?

maya: Thurs 10am. Please add notes to the central doc by Wed EOD.

sonja: Billing note: every lane needs a billing_tag and cost-allocation path. Also ensure lane-specific rate_limits to prevent noisy-neighbors.

eli: SRE concern: cross-region failover can cause transient p99 spikes due to cold KV caches and different kernel perf. Proposal: progressive traffic shifts with warmup windows + quality budget checks.

sam: Draft policy snippet (WIP):
```
lane: "enterprise-gold"
residency: "eu-west-1"
fallback_order: ["regional-affinity", "shared-pool"]
model_compat: { quantized_ok: true, f16_ok: false }
quality_budget_pct: 2
rollout_phases: ["ff_canary", "small_ab", "ramp"]
```
Runtime must evaluate model_compat and pick an appropriate variant at route time.

rolf: Runbook excerpt: if eviction_rate > 0.4% over 10m -> activate eviction-mitigation (autoscale+route-new-sessions-to-fallback) and notify SRE pager. Also require KV-cache hit-rate > 55% within 4m before canary step.

jana: I'll paste contract snippet examples (data residency clause, SLA p99 targets, force-majeure fallback language).

ben: Prioritization matrix link added to doc. I'll score initial asks and flag 2 as high-impact/high-effort.

deploy-bot: created doc https://redwood.internal/docs/tenancy-roadmap-synthesis and branch routing/tenancy-synth-2945678901

taylor: Got it - will slot the deck and add a single slide with the scoring heatmap.

maya: Thanks all. Please put PRs/notes into the branch before Wed EOD. We'll finalize owners and launch gates at the Thurs review.

sonja: One last: track model-variant quality diffs (e.g., BLEU/ROUGE or eval set delta) as part of canary acceptance, not just latency.

eli: Agree. Add a metric: quality_delta_pct and must be <= quality_budget_pct during canary.

maya: Perfect. See you at the review. :pray:
